results.title: The Atlantic reveals why Elon Musk is refusing to let Ukraine use Starlink for strikes on Russian territory
results.description: American billionaire and SpaceX owner Elon Musk is currently refusing to allow Ukraine to use Starlink satellite internet for strikes on Russian territory because he believes it is time Ukraine concluded a peace deal with Russia.

results.title: Belarus joins Russia’s war on freedom of information
results.description: Belarus’ obscure decision to ban Euronews’ website on its territory follows Russia’s blocking of all Euronews content, as both nations continue to clamp down on the media.
